answer_1.quote: We selected question generation, question answering, and summarization as the three NLG domains on which we assessed the NND framework.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated questions, answers, and summaries across three NLG tasks using the proposed NND framework.

answer_2.quote: We compare NND to standard n-gram based evaluation metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, as well as more recent Transformer-based metrics: BERTScore, BARTScore and QuestEval.

answer_4.quote: Ten teachers designing educational quizzes annotated 3,164 questions with one of four error types: No Error, Disfluent, Off Target, Wrong Context.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled each generated question with one of four error types: No Error, Disfluent, Off Target, Wrong Context.
